pan.recipe: Photo 1260px wide in 1080 frame: translateX 0 to -140px plus scale 1.06 to 1.10 over 4.5s; next scene reverses (+140px). Caption fixed at y=1380-1560.
pan.restraint: No pauses mid-scene; image pixels must visibly change at least every 1.5s.

parallax.recipe: Two layers from one photo: back copy blurred 8px at scale 1.15 drifts X +60px; front masked center crop drifts X -120px over 4s; caption layer static at y=1300-1500.
parallax.restraint: Depth comes from layer offset only; text never moves with the image layers.

wipe.recipe: clip-path inset reveals next scene right to left in 380ms. Outgoing caption reaches opacity 0 by 120ms; incoming caption fades in only after the wipe ends.
wipe.restraint: One wipe direction per video; only one scene's text is visible during a wipe.

split.recipe: Split at y=960: top photo enters X -1080 to 0, bottom enters X 1080 to 0, 360ms; then they pan 120px in opposite directions over 3s. Caption sits in y=900-1020 after landing.
split.restraint: Keep caption within x=60-1020; no text during panel entry.

grid.recipe: 2x2 grid of 510x640 cells, 20px margins and gutters, at y=120-1420. Cells scale .92 to 1 with 90ms stagger, 370ms total; each then zooms 1.00 to 1.08 over 3s. Caption at y=1460-1600.
grid.restraint: Max 4 cells; captions never overlap the cells.

stack.recipe: Cards 880x1180 at x=100, y=260. Next card rises from y+1920 to rest at -24px and ±2deg in 380ms; the prior card dims to .7 and scales to .96. Top card drifts 110px X over 3s.
stack.restraint: Max 3 cards; the caption belongs to the top card only.

flip.recipe: Outgoing rotateY 0 to 90deg (180ms), then incoming -90 to 0deg (180ms), perspective 1600px, backface hidden. After landing, photo scales 1.04 to 1.10 over 3s.
flip.restraint: No text mid-flip; use at most twice per video.

punch.recipe: On a beat, crop jumps scale 1.0 to 1.18 toward the product focal point in 200ms. Next beat goes 1.18 to 1.32 with a 40px offset. Between beats, the image drifts 120px.
punch.restraint: Max 3 punches per scene; caption stays fixed and is never scaled.

whip.recipe: Outgoing translateX 0 to -1080px and incoming 1080 to 0, 340ms total. A 12px motion blur peaks mid-move and clears to 0 by the end.
whip.restraint: Alternate direction on each whip; clear the caption before the whip, then show the next one after.

slide.recipe: Caption block slides X 60px to 0 with opacity 0 to 1 over 400ms, inside x=60-1020, y=1240-1560, then holds while the image behind pans 120px.
slide.restraint: Avoid the badge zone; caption fades out over 200ms before any transition.

kinetic.recipe: Inside one data-text wrapper, word spans rise translateY 40 to 0 with fade-in, 70ms stagger, 360ms each. Wrapper bounds x=60-1020, y=1200-1600.
kinetic.restraint: Preserve exact copy, spacing and order; never split Hangul syllables.

badge.recipe: Round 220px badge at x=780-1000, y=160-380 scales .6 to 1 in 320ms, then holds while the image keeps moving beneath it.
badge.restraint: Only verified price or deal facts; if there are none, omit the badge. Never invent amounts or percentages.

light-leak.recipe: Warm amber CSS radial-gradient in screen blend, max 18% opacity, sweeps X -300 to +300px over 2.4s across a transition or the end card.
light-leak.restraint: No strobing or flicker; never exceed 20% opacity; CSS only, no external files.

grain.recipe: Inline SVG feTurbulence noise at 5% opacity in overlay blend drifts 40px over 6s. On the end card, text holds while the photo scales 1.00 to 1.06.
grain.restraint: Cap opacity at 6%; no per-frame jitter; grain must never be the only motion.
